|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Finalizer (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee high-resolution card image of this version ([[:File:V4-D-finalizer_ai-2021-08-10-hires.png]]); no card-size GIF of this image was ever committed, which is why it was missing from the version list until the PC's high-resolution images were compared with the card-size images (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-finalizeraipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/finalizer_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/finalizer_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Executor”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 4 [First Order] starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys -4 to [Episode VII] systems and adds 1 to your Force drains there. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Finalizer (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021): re-made for the PC's January 2022 Alternate Image update: the copyright line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd.” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, and the art credit, icons and text box were redrawn or moved. PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-Dark793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/finalizer_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/finalizer_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “''Executor''”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 4 [First Order] starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys -4 to [Episode VII] systems and adds 1 to your Force drains there. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Finalizer (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): '''First published 31 May 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/finalizer_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-Darke8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/finalizer_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/finalizer_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' small re-rendering differences in the image (visible when zoomed; see the crops); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “''Executor''”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 4 [First Order] starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys -4 to [Episode VII] systems and adds 1 to your Force drains there. Immune to attrition < 5.” This image was first published on 31 May 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/finalizer_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Finalizer (ALT) (Errata 3)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/finalizer_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-Dark12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/finalizer_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/finalizer_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>.
